name: chatbot-widget
description: Drop-in React chat widget with SSE streaming, session persistence, and human escalation
postMessage: Import <ChatWidget> and pass your ChatConfig. See index.ts for all exports.
notes: The CSS import (`import './styles/widget.css'`) in ChatWidget.tsx requires a bundler that handles CSS imports (Vite, webpack, Next.js, etc.). If your setup does not support CSS imports, load widget.css via a <link> tag and remove the import line from ChatWidget.tsx.
